usedFor: Cal ID holds bookings, and Conversion Chats runs “Send Template Message” after “Booking Requested” or “Booking Rescheduled”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Rescheduled” in Cal ID, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A rescheduled booking changes the plan, so the template message can reach the customer with the update.

watchOut: “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats reaches a customer, so each message waits in Needs you for approval.
